label: REPLAY (no key)
recorded: 2026-11-12, duckdb 1.1.3. P2 fetched with demos/_shared/data-packs/synthea-analytics/fetch.sh from release data-p2-synthea-analytics-10k-v1, sha256 5f803a524ba57b31067657a0c9a0e6d009bc0d2b62115abdc79c6412bbc20cef, verify.py PASS
control: Share of type 2 diabetes (SNOMED 44054006) HbA1c results (LOINC 4548-4) under 7%. mmol/mol is converted first: NGSP % = 0.09148 * IFCC mmol/mol + 2.152

queries.q1_monthly: with dm as (select distinct patient from 'PACK/parquet/conditions.parquet' where code = '44054006'), a as (select o.date, o.units, o.value_num as v, case when o.units = 'mmol/mol' then 0.09148 * o.value_num + 2.152 else o.value_num end as pct from 'PACK/parquet/observations.parquet' o join dm using (patient) where o.code = '4548-4') select strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') as mon, count(*) as n, sum((units = 'mmol/mol')::int) as mmol_rows, round(100.0 * avg((v < 7)::int), 1) as naive_pct, round(100.0 * avg((pct < 7)::int), 1) as normalized_pct from a where date >= DATE '2026-01-01' and date < DATE '2026-05-01' group by 1 order by 1
queries.q1_unit_change: select strftime(min(date) filter (where units = 'mmol/mol'), '%Y-%m-%d') as first_mmol, sum((units = 'mmol/mol')::int) as mmol_rows, sum((units = '%')::int) as pct_rows from 'PACK/parquet/observations.parquet' where code = '4548-4'
queries.q2: select strftime(date_trunc('month', start), '%Y-%m') as mon, count(*) as n from 'PACK/parquet/encounters.parquet' group by 1 order by n asc, mon asc limit 1
queries.q2_types: with m as (select strftime(date_trunc('month', start), '%Y-%m') as mon, count(*) as n from 'PACK/parquet/encounters.parquet' group by 1 order by n asc, mon asc limit 1) select e.description, count(*) as n from 'PACK/parquet/encounters.parquet' e join m on strftime(date_trunc('month', e.start), '%Y-%m') = m.mon group by 1 order by n desc, 1 limit 1
queries.q3: with per as (select patient, count(*) as n from 'PACK/parquet/encounters.parquet' group by 1), ranked as (select n, ntile(10) over (order by n desc, patient) as decile from per) select sum(n) filter (where decile = 1) as top_decile_visits, sum(n) as visits from ranked

p2-10k.name: P2 synthea-analytics-10k (10,000 living patients, 11,842 patient rows)

answers.q1: HbA1c results started arriving in mmol/mol on 2026-03-07 (2,126 rows from then on). A percent threshold reads those as out of control. Naive control fell from 96.8% in February to 68.1% in March. After converting mmol/mol to percent, March is 93.4% (April 93.8%). The unit change explains about 25 of the 28.7 points. A smaller drop of about 3.4 points remains after conversion and is not explained here.
answers.q2: October 2023 had the fewest visits, 4,136. The largest visit type that month was Encounter for problem (procedure), 1,100.
answers.q3: The busiest 10% of patients account for 84,104 of 167,424 visits (50.2%).
